summary: Noise abatement departure procedures for runway 26 at EGBJ, including jets climbing straight ahead to 1,400 ft before turning.
text:
NOISE ABATEMENT PROCEDURES - DEPARTURES RUNWAY 26
1. NON-JET AIRCRAFT (INCLUDING CIRCUIT AIRCRAFT) REQUIRING A RIGHT
TURN SHOULD:
-TURN RIGHT AFTER PASSING THE MIDDLE OF THE GOLF COURSE AND JUST
PRIOR TO OVERFLYING THE ESTATE (HIGHGROVE) SITUATED TO THE WEST OF
THE AIRPORT.
-NOT ROUTE OVER THE VILLAGE OF DOWN HATHERLEY.
-BE AWARE OF POSSIBLE HELICOPTER CIRCUIT ACTIVITY ROUTING TO THE
WEST AND NORTH OF THE JET AGE MUSEUM.
2. NON-JET AIRCRAFT (INCLUDING CIRCUIT AIRCRAFT) REQUIRING A LEFT
TURN SHOULD:
-BE AWARE OF BUILT UP AREAS TO THE SOUTH WEST OF THE AIRFIELD AND
OF CHOSEN HILL.
3. JET AIRCRAFT ARE TO CLIMB STRAIGHT AHEAD THROUGH 1400FT QNH
BEFORE EXECUTING ANY TURN.
4. HELICOPTERS USING RUNWAY 26 ARE ALSO REQUIRED TO FOLLOW
PUBLISHED NOISE ABATEMENT PROCEDURES OR AS INSTRUCTED BY ATC.
UK AIP EGBJ AD 2.21, ITEM C REFERS.
